lokele: Imi Paulo Botomomu wa Masiya Yesu ko l’eoka ya lioi lia isosha sha Mungu Bouwesi wasu la eoka ya Masiya Yesu oyale iɛli shasu,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ 1:1 Christ Jesus the Lord. our hope,

lokele: ende Timoteo wana wami wa wewe nda lilendelu; booto la shota la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango la Masiya Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu biyaleke laɛ! Loasɔ loa bato bamɔi ebatoekesa Bikela ko efinole
english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

lokele: Kwa alɔmbɔkɔlɔkɔ’mi aɛ ani aɛkɛ’mi okakɛ nda Makedonia, ongoma tikalaka kɔni nda Efeso mbo oteke eb’asisa ndola mbo bataekekesa liekesi lia bɔfɔnɔ wasi,
english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

lokele: la mbo batasilesa mbile yau nda bembila ya njasɔ ya fɛtɔ ya oso ebitofɔɔlɔ tofenya etoitokɔkɔmɛsɛ likɔmɔnyi lia Mungu elile nda lilendelu.
english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

lokele: Nde litina lia liekesi lile ngo ko losamɔ elotokuswa nda botema botanu la eluwelo elau yolembeela njasɔ la lilendelu eliti la bolimbake.
english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

lokele: Bamɔi basotwanelo la basolota nda mboka ya njasɔ-bi la basokwa nda beongaonga;
english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

lokele: bale la yɛmɛ yoyala baekesi ba Bikela ya Mose, nde batiluwe baoi ebasoong’iyo ango ko litina imɔ lia njasɔ ebitoekes’iyo bato.
english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

lokele: Nde tosoluwa mbo Bikela bile bilau, eya to mbo boto kolitesa yao la wɛlï,
english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

lokele: ani toluwi nde mbo Bikela bitiatelomoko eba liengani, kangä ebatiengane la eba totefola, bato babe l’ebale la batwanelo, ebati balau, ebatokwaka baiti, batefwesi ba sango, batefwesi ba nyango la baoli ba bato,
english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

lokele: la bato ba nyongo, l’ebatotombolana bindo la tosumbe, l’ebatoungesa bato angɛnɛ, l’eba nanga, l’ebatotombola ekanɔ yau, l’ebatokelaka ko njasɔ yasi ebitwani la liekesi lilau,
english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

lokele: eliengani nde la Mboli Ilau ya tala ya Mungu wa lokemo, biko Mboli Ilau ebifomu’mi mbo inangoleke yao. Kelekele ya Paulo ende Mungu eoka ya linangoli lia Mboli Ilau
english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

lokele: Imi nd’asofaef’Inde kelekele oyasɔɔlɛsɛ’mi bofoka wokela ongoma, Inde ako Masiya Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu, mbo atangi nde mbo yende yolendelomo ndotomomo nda likuwa liande,
english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

lokele: ani oso yayalaka bɔsɛɔli la bokongokoli oyabebesak’Inde finɛ; kongo ko yafomoko shota eoka yakelaka ongoma ani ikoyali ko botutuku l’angwɛnɛ liimeli,
english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

lokele: nde bootaota wa Ngɛnɛ wasu bosoelwela’mi la bosotumesa’mi fuu, bu ko la lilendelu la losamɔ loa Masiya Yesu.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Liölo-li liende wewe la liondu ndolendelomo la batotina liko mbo— Masiya Yesu ayaka ono nda wenda-bo mbo uweseke bato abe. La imi angɛnɛ yende ewa obe wetela;
english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

lokele: kongo ko yawɛlɔmɔkɔ shota ko la litina-li liko mbo nda loasɔ loami, kwa ewa oso, Yesu Masiya ɛnɛsɛkɛ iso bato liombakeli liande eliti liowa esole, kwa ekweelo end’iyo ana ebakalendeloko Inde loasɔ loa loiko loa layalaya.
english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

lokele: Lilitesi la tala bifomoko ende Bɔkɔta Oyatilawek’imɔ ko layalaya, oyaitɔɛnɛlɛ, oyayali ko Inde angɛnɛ ngo ko Mungu wa lokato loa layalaya, ongoma!
english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

lokele: Timoteo wana wami, isotel’aɛ ndola-ye kwa aongelomoko aɛ k’oso mbo ko la isosha sha baoi ana onaneke bita bilau,
english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

lokele: ani okɔkɔmɛli la lilendelu la eluwelo elau yolembeela njasɔ, nde bamɔi basofekela eluwelo, limɔ lilendelu liau lisolinda mbii kwa watɔ nda liande.
english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

lokele: Humanayo la Alesandelo bende bato ba bɔfɔnɔ-bo, la isofa iyo ende Satana mbo baekesomoko ndomacha lisɛɔli lia Mungu.
english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

lokele: Isotafelak’ino oso to, mbo osomboleke, ömbeke, olɔmbɔkɔlɛkɛ ko la kelekele, loasɔ loa bato ba kanda bitotina,
english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

lokele: la eoka ya bɛkɔta l’ebasotaliomo l’isosha, litina mbo boyaeli wasu boyaleke la lilatemi la liɔngɛsu la lilitesi lia Mungu la bato lisanga.
english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

lokele: Ongoma lole lolau la losokuliomo nda baiso ba Mungu Bouwesi wasu,
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

lokele: oyalɛmbi mbo bato batotina buwesomoko la mbo biyeleke ko nda liluwani lia wewe.
english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

lokele: Eoka Mungu ende ko Ɔmwito la Ikomya atiteni ya Mungu la bato ko Ɔmwito kongo, ako Boto ko Masiya Yesu,
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

lokele: oyafak’Inde angɛnɛ kwa liendoli lia batotina la inango-si sianangolomoko nda lisho elioengana.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

lokele: Imi nd’atomoko bonangoli la Botomomu nda likuwa-li, isoonga ko momongo, itite lolanga, ko ndoekekesa bato ba tukela ya wenda njasɔ ya lilendelu l’eya wewe.
english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

lokele: Isosanga to mbo batolome batolakeke oso nda lisomboli nda tukela bitotina, ani batoilaka besamba betanu l’angwɛnɛ lisomi la tofenya;
english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

lokele: la mbo batomali bawateke bisinda yoengana la wɛlï la limama la sɔni, inga to la swee ya belowa, la bisinda ebile la bɔfɛkɔ wa falata, la tokɛikɛli, la bisinda ya loketi lofi,
english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not 2:9 with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

lokele: kongo ko bayaleke la boyaeli la bekeeli bilau kwa aondu nde la batomali ebasoaolela likuwa lia Mungu.
english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

lokele: Botomali ayaleke la lilitesi lia boeki la tau la liikami sefinɛnde
english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

lokele: itikulye botomali ndoekesa nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ ango ndokomya batolome, kangä ndoyala tau.
english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

lokele: Eoka Adamu akelomoko oto oso, limɔ Awa mbisa;
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

lokele: la Adamu atialimbomoko, kangä otomali nd’alimbomoko mbo akweke nda bobe.
english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

lokele: Nde batomali buwesomoko ngo ko nda lioti lia bana, eya to mbo bekɔkɔmɛlɛ nda lilendelu la losamɔ la botanu ebowatemani la limama.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

lokele: Liölo-li liende wewe mbo— Boto eluka ndoyala Bokumi wa Etanda, ambo ale la yɛmɛ ya likuwa lilau.
english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer 3:1 desires a good work.

lokele: Eokao loengani nde mbo Bokumi ayaleke boto oyati ango la litwanelo, bolome wa wali ɔmwito kongo, boto oyatiwe bänä, oyaluwi nde njasɔ la wɛlï, boto wa likɔmɔnyi, oyatonyangela bɛɛnda, boekesi bolau,
english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

lokele: inga boto wa bosho nda bänä, kwa bosaesae, kangä bɔfɔɔmu oyatilɛmbɛ bosho, boto oyatisame ko bieto.
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

lokele: Ayaleke boto oyatokomya bofindi wande angɛnɛ la wɛlï, la oyatokakalesa bana bande la lilitesi lilau.
english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

lokele: ¿Eoka eya mbo atiluwe ndokomya bofindi wande angɛnɛ, inde kokukya to Etanda ya Mungu la moni?
english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

lokele: Ayaleke boto w’Etanda oyakumwi sumbu, mbo atafaala la bɔmɛtɔ wokwes’inde nda lifomu se lia Satana.
english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

lokele: Nde ayaleke imɔ la lokuku lolau ende ebati b’Etanda mbo atatombolomo la mbo atakwa nda ilonga sha Satana.
english: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

lokele: Basungi b’Etanda imɔ ko ongoma, bayaleke la lilitesi lia liatemi, inga la bɛnɔkɔ imbale, inga bawi bänä la ebasolola lisɔnji lia bieto wike;
english: Servants, 3:8 in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

lokele: kangä ebatoundaka njasɔ ya lilendelu ebisoisolomo, ko la eluweelo elau yolembeela litina.
english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

lokele: Iyo imɔ batakɔtɔlɔmɔkɔ, limɔ ango batiyale la loasɔ angɔlɔmɔi, bakeleke likuwa lia Basungi.
english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve 3:10 if they are blameless.

lokele: Batomali ebale Basungi imɔ ko ongoma, bayaleke la lilitesi lia lilatemi, inga tomwatomwa, inga bawi bänä, kangä bolendelomo nda bitotina.
english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

lokele: Basungi batolome bayaleke nde batolome ba wali ɔmwito, l’ebatokomya bana bau la befindi yau angɛnɛ la wɛlï;
english: Let servants 3:12 be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

lokele: eoka ebatokelaka likuwa lia Bosungi la wɛlï batofomo loliteso lolau la batokwelo lotendela loa lilendelu liolendelo Masiya Yesu.
english: For those who have served well 3:13 gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Isosɔnɛl’aɛ bakakanelo-ba ani isokɛsɛ iɛli shoyɛn’aɛ mbisa ya mbile ko sinyo,
english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

lokele: nde yeumwa oya end’ino, ani isosɔnɛl’aɛ mbo oluweke boyaeli ewengani lasu nda bofindi wa Mungu, boko Etanda ya Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa liwawi eyele likole la esukameselo ya njasɔ ya wewe.
english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

lokele: Toisoaola nde mbo njasɔ ya lisemoli lia Mungu ebisoisoelomo iso bile ngo ko likama fafo, mbo— Masiya ɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ̈ nda boyaeli wasu balomboki, enganesomokö ko la Bolimo, ɛnɔmɔkɔ̈ fololo la bakitomo. Anangoelomokö ende tukela ya wenda-bo, akuliomokö la bato ba wenda; ilomokö nda Use okataliomo tala omao.
english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God 3:16 was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

lokele: Bolimo atoonga to lasu fololo mbo nda bacho ba liili bamɔi basu batosɛnyana la Lilendelu ko ndolaikila balimo ba bolimbakeli la liekesi lia balimo babe,
english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

lokele: ko la shɔngɔlɔ sha bɛnɔkɔ ya eba nanga. Biluwelo ya baekesi-ba bisobeba la bösä wa bobe,
english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

lokele: batofekela bato ndosɔngɔnɔ la batofumbesa bokili wa yeka yola ebiakelaka Mungu mbo eba liimeli la liluwani lia wewe baaeleke yao ko la kelekëlë.
english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

lokele: Eoka bitotina ebikelomu la Mungu bile bilau, angwɛnɛ ango ɛmɔi yokilomo ani esoaelomo ko la kelekëlë;
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

lokele: eoka ani esüchomo ko la lioi lia Mungu la lisomboli. Beimo la bakakanelo-ba bekesomoko ende Etanda
english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

lokele: Bosanokoela eba Etanda bakakanelo-ba, ani otoyala bokuwani olau wa Masiya Yesu oyasokɔsɔlɔmɔ la baoi ba lilendelu la liekesi lilau elisotut’aɛ otutaka liao.
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

lokele: Fekaka ndoka bishä la bembila ya batata ebiti la lisungi; fumbesaka aɛ angɛnɛ ndoeka bosemoeli wa Mungu.
english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

lokele: Lifumbesi lia bindo lile la lisungi sumbu nde lifumbesi lia lilitesi lia Mungu litosungak’iso nda njasɔ bitotina eoka lisɔɔlɛs’iso lisakä lia loiko loa kwanikwani la eloa mbisa imɔ lisanga.
english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

lokele: Liolo-li liende wewe la liondu ndolendelomo la batotina;
english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

lokele: ko l’eokao tosofumba la bonui kwa eba liangɔ, eoka mbo iɛli shau sile ngo ko ende Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa liwawi, Oyayali Bouwesi wa bato batotina, nde simbi to wa eba lilendelu.
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

lokele: Taka ndola la ekesaka Etanda njasɔ-bi.
english: Command and teach these things.

lokele: Boto angɔmɔi ataolya aɛ eoka ya isɛngɛ shaɛ, kongo ko yalaka etichelo ende eba lilendelu, la nda baoi baɛ, la boyaeli, la losamɔ, la lilendelu, la botema botanu waɛ.
english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

lokele: Kond’akayeke’mi, tinganaka la litangi nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la linangoli la liekesi lia lioi lia Mungu.
english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

lokele: Olenjëke isosha esile laɛ la eshafomoko aɛ ko la litɔndɔli la lotalio loa besamba ya biange ya Etanda.
english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

lokele: Enyaka njasɔ-bi ndotimbakana la yao la bofiili mbo batotina bɛnɛkɛ mbo osɔkɛ la oso.
english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

lokele: Tinganaka la botema waɛ angɛnɛ la liekesi imɔ, kɔkɔmɔkɔ nda yao; bokelaka ongoma, otouwesa l’aɛ angɛnɛ la ebatokak’aɛ lisanga.
english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

lokele: Ofëke botowange liɛngɔ, kangä koim’inde la wɛlï kwa mbo sango waɛ; imaka tosenge kwa mbo bitungani yaɛ;
english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

lokele: biange ya batomali kwa mbo banyango, besängä la baseka kwambo baelo baɛ la botema botanu nda njasɔ bitotina. Loasɔ loa ebawelu balome
english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

lokele: Litesaka la kukyaka ebawelu balome la bato bau wewe,
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

lokele: nde eya to mbo lotika eyala la bana, ango ko bana babana bande, bataekaka mbo lole end’iyo ndokeela bofindi wau angɛnɛ booto la ndoinoela ebaot’iyo ko losamɔ eoka ongoma yengani nde nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is 5:4 acceptable in the sight of God.

lokele: Nde botomali oyawelu olome la oyale lotika wewe, asokokomɛsɛ iɛli shande la atotumbanela liömbi la lisomboli ko la ocho la löwa.
english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

lokele: Nde lotika oyaokanelu nde bamɛngo bande, inde asowa ani akowawa kɔni.
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

lokele: Komyak’imo ko loasɔ-lo mbo batatwanelo ango sinyo.
english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

lokele: Nde boto elenjaka ndokukya eba bofindi, simbi to ebaot’inde angɛnɛ, ambo asoanganya Liimeli, l’ani ale la obe wolongela oyatiimele.
english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

lokele: Otëke lina lia lotika nda lokasa ani akaiyeli miaka kama liambɛ, la sakolo ko ayalaka wali wa boto ko ɔmɔi,
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

lokele: la mbo ayali nde la lokuku lolau eoka ya bekeeli bilau, ambo oyasokosolo bana, oyasonyangela bɛɛnda nda lɔkɛndɔ loau, oyasosoola batindi b’eba Etanda, oyasosungaka eba touwe, oyasotimbana la bakuwa balau ba kanda bitotina.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

lokele: Nde otëke lina lia lotika oyati wange, eoka atatɛkwa ndolitesa Masiya, ko ndolɛmbe ndɔkɛ liäla liasi,
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

lokele: limɔ atofomo se eoka mbo asotombola lisakä lia oso.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

lokele: La imɔ ko batokwelo bato ba bewandu oketete la ndakɔ la ndakɔ, tinga ko bewandu kongo, kangä imɔ fomboli la betendele la tolailai ebatotaka mboli ebitiengane lau.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

lokele: Eokao ilɛmbi finɛ mbo ebawelu balome ebakayi biange baɛkɛ baäla basi baoteke bana la bakomanyeke bofindi wau angɛnɛ mbo batafa Wiyani fofe yotombola Etanda.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

lokele: Nde bamɔi basosila oko okatute Satana.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

lokele: Eya to mbo oto w’Etanda eyala la tika ya olome olo eyande, asungek’iyo la wɛlï, la Etanda etafomo bolito ona, la mbo Etanda esungeke tika yasi ebati l’ato bosungak’iyo. Loasɔ loa biange la bekumi ya Etanda
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

lokele: Biange y’Etanda ebitokomya likuwa liau la wɛlï, bengani nde ndɔɔlɔ loliteso lofi, simbi to ebasokelaka likuwa lifi lia linangoli la liekesi;
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

lokele: eoka Lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Okandëke bolomba wa mbolo oyatomatekela befonga nda etwangelo, la imɔ mbo— Bosali engani nde ndofomo liɔli liande.
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” Deuteronomy 25:4 And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.” Luke 10:7

lokele: Okuliëke liwanjeli liowanjela wange w’Etanda sakolo ngo ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya bato bambale kwa asatɔ ebɛnɛkɛ loasɔ.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

lokele: Nde ebasofomo se nda njasɔ, fak’iyo liɛngɔ oso wa baiso ba batotina mbo ebamɔi imɔ bawaeke.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

lokele: Itoimak’aɛ la wɛlï oso wa Mungu la oso wa Masiya Yesu la bakitomo ebaaomu lande, mbo okɔchɛkɛ bakakanelo-ba, angwɛnɛ ikwelakwela la angokɛlɛ ɔngɔ ɔmɔi.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

lokele: Otalielëke boto bosamba waɛ la mangu, angosangana la batwanelo ba bato basi; yalesaka ewaɛ botema la botanu.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

lokele: Omwëk’imɔ ko baliä ko balia kongo, nde taka sinyo sha liamɔ eoka ya sɔlɔ yaɛ la biale ebisokak’aɛ mbile la mbile.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

lokele: Batwanelo ba bato bamɔi bisɔɛnɛlɛ sandelele ndokakɛs’iyo ko nda lofomo se, nde eba bato basi batokatutel’iyo liili.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

lokele: Ko ongoma imɔ bekeeli bilau bisɔɛnɛlɛ swa, la ango bitiɛnɛlɛ ongoma, yao bitikɔkɔlɛ ndoisakama.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

lokele: Bato ebaundakomu bɛkɔwa bafaefeke bangɛnɛ bau lilitesi kwa aondu lau, mbo lina lia Mungu la liekesi lia njasɔ yande litamɔlɔkɔmɔ.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

lokele: Ango ebale la bangɛnɛ ebayali b’Etanda baolyëke bangɛnɛ bau eoka mbo bende beoto b’Etanda; kongo ko bakuwekelek’iyo la lilitesi lioeta eoka ebatokuwelomo la wɛlï bende b’Etanda la ebasamomu lau. Ekesaka la fumbesaka ongoma. Beimo la bakakanelo basi
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

lokele: Eya to mbo boto ekekesa la bɔfɔnɔ wasi la atikulye baölo-ba balau ba Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya la liekesi lilau lia Mungu,
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

lokele: ambo ona asotuta la bɔmɛtɔ ani wewe atiluwe yeka, ale ko la loo nda botema elotofɔɔlɔ tofenya la liwesani eoka ya baoi, elitokusola imɔ luno la bosho la litɔngi lia bato basi la toloi tobe,
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

lokele: bato ana batowalakana eoka betema yau bitiluw’imɔ wewe la batangi nde mbo lisemoli lia Mungu lile ko fofe yɔɔlɔ yeka.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such. 6:5

lokele: Eingo, liende la fofe yɔɔlɔ yeka ya likama bu ko la liɔngɛsu lia yɛmɛ;
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

lokele: eoka totiaeshaka yeka angɔmɔi lasu nda wenda-bo la totikɔkɔlɛ ndosokwa la yeka,
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

lokele: kongo ko toyala la yeka yola la eyowataka, ambo toaeseke betema se la yao.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

lokele: Nde ebasosanga ndofota la bieto, basokwa nda lisoshela la ilonga sha yɛmɛ ibe ebitoiyesa bato nda liöma la losɛɛsɛlɔ.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

lokele: Eoka yɛmɛ ya bieto wike ele litina lia njasɔ ibe wike; la eoka mbo bamɔi basoongwamela yao, basolota mboka ya lilendelu la basotwɛlɛkɛ betema yau angɛnɛ la saka ya tɔkɛnɛnɛ. Liölo loasɔ loa Timoteo angɛnɛ
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

lokele: Nde aɛ angɛnɛ, Boto wa Mungu, engwaka njasɔ bitotina bina la botili; engelaka nde ko liengani, la lilitesi lia Mungu, lilendelu la losamɔ, la likɔkɔmɛlɛ la botema sambo.
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

lokele: Fumbaka nda liangɔ lilau lia lilendelu; kusamelaka loiko loa layalaya elosotomelomo aɛ lioi la eloaolelak’aɛ nda baiso ba batangeli wike.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

lokele: Isotel’aɛ likakanelo-li oso wa baiso ba Mungu oyasosɛlɛkɛ batotina la liwawi, la oso wa baiso ba Masiya Yesu oyaaolelaka la lisanoli lilau ende Pontio Pilato,
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

lokele: mbo ɔkɔchɛkɛ ekela ena l’angwɛnɛ ango litongwi konda liɛnɛlɛ lia Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya;
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

lokele: lilaɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ nda lisho liande angɛnɛ ako Inde oyale Bokakalesi wa lokemo, Ngɛnɛ ko Ɔmwito, Bɔkɔta wa bɛkɔta la Ngɛnɛ wa bangɛnɛ.
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

lokele: Inde angɛnɛ kongo nd’ayali la loiko elotilawek’imɔ la oyayali nda liangangi eliti liowana la boto, Oyatiɛnɔmɔ la boto, atikɔkɔlɛ ndoɛnɛ Inde. Loomalo la tososha bifomoko end’Inde ko layalaya. Ongoma.
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

lokele: Imaka bafoka ba wenda wa mbile-ye mbo batafaala la bɔmɛtɔ, angokɛsɛ tɔɛli twau nda lifoka elile ngo ko wawa, kangä ende Mungu oyatofaekef’iso lifoti lia bitotina ebitoomakales’iso.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

lokele: Nde bakeleke bekeeli ya booto, bafotakeke ko la bakuwa balau la basukaneke la basi basaɔ la bakaeleke bakaɔ;
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

lokele: la ongoma batosɔnjɛlɛ bondanda wau bolau eoka ya mbile ebilayeke, mbo baɔlɛkɛ loiko loa wewe.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

lokele: Ee Timoteo, tinganaka la loao elosotikomo laɛ! Taka bɔkɔngɔ nda beongaonga la tofenya ebile ko wawa, ebitotangomo la bamɔi mbo wɛlï finɛ.
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

lokele: Bamɔi ebasoimela wɛlï-ao basoomelo lilendelu angɛnɛ. Booto wa Mungu boyaleke laɛ.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
